answer: A new key may wander the public log with zero weight. Influence begins only at dawn: the first unaffiliated payer who bonds slashable stake, and who attests at a wall-clock hour no batch of clones can occupy together. After that bond, every later endorsement must travel a canyon of delayed, fully clawed payouts and irregular partners — a path no lock-step script can stamp onto a thousand identities at once — so a farm of quiet copies is a net loss, not a shortcut.
